items: Consolidate candidate, access, URL, original and QA issues.
See the exact decision, reason, original and prior history.

measurements.title: Admission and identity
measurements.scope: Current source base: 87 identities; new-candidate browser admission remains maintainer-assisted.
measurements.method: Compare source identities and named decisions before/after the controlled transition. Exercise new, duplicate and declined candidates; check that only accepted candidates obtain a formal identity.
measurements.conclusion: No autonomous discovery provider is configured. Candidate admission and source-population completeness have no measured accuracy percentage.

measurements.title: Acquisition and preservation
measurements.scope: Normal-load preservation and current 38-record intake are different populations.
measurements.method: Match original fingerprints and version lineage before/after the bounded load. Reconcile all intake records to a parse outcome or a located source follow-up. Exercise failed replacement while keeping the previous valid original.
measurements.conclusion: Stored bytes do not establish complete source content. System2A can still return an empty-body finding. No source was reacquired for this diagram.

measurements.title: Governance and weekly checks
measurements.scope: Five source dimensions; Monday design count of five eligible source records.
measurements.method: Bind each rating and confidence to the exact source evidence and calibrated scope. Check all hard gates and human holds. Sample eligible records without duplicate stage/week batches; retain shortfalls and open findings.
measurements.conclusion: Weekly agreement is reported only for complete reviewed batches. It is not calibration or complete source-coverage evidence.

measurements.title: Durable handoff and outputs
measurements.scope: Checkpoint 15 preserves all five owning business/history stores and normal source revision 1.
measurements.method: Compare owning business tables and originals before/after the controlled action. Check source-version guards and saved/exported revision equality. Review stale requests, failed exports and downstream eligibility loss separately.
measurements.conclusion: The source package is not an extracted Requirement dataset. No Source1 timing is inferred from the separate System2 performance cohort.

items: Use bound original regions, full-table context and the stated reason.
Check surrounding text, headers, notes and dependencies.
Keep every addition and structural repair anchored to the original.
Named decisions are durable; a saved draft is incomplete.

human.rule: Source problems return to System1. A repairs preserve source meaning; deciding which content is a Requirement belongs to B.

measurements.title: Format and coverage scope
measurements.scope: 31 readable materials out of 38 records. Fidelity diagnosis: one PDF, 8 exposed pages and 275 original regions.
measurements.method: Reconcile every input with a declared outcome. Compare all reference regions, including absent output. Count a complete region only when content, structure and controlling relations agree. Evaluate real scans/mixed pages as a separate representative cohort.
measurements.conclusion: 31/31 parsing completion is not source-fidelity acceptance. The scan repair fixture is synthetic and does not qualify real scan accuracy.

measurements.title: Reconstruction and cross-page joins
measurements.scope: Parser 04: 125 cells, 12 relations and 3 whole tables. Implemented joins still require independent qualification.
measurements.method: Match exact cells, spans and expected relationships. For text/table joins, label exact fragment pairs: precision = correct/predicted joins; recall = correct/required joins. Check wrong joins, missed joins, repeated headers and row completeness. Proposed criterion: ≥98% each; retain fragment evidence.
measurements.conclusion: Join code and physical fragments do not prove correct assembly. Q04 CER 0.13%; Q05 WER 0.90% report only; Q06 tokens 211/211; Q09 order 20/20; Q11 pages 0/8. Broad diagnostic scores cannot replace exact join labels.

measurements.title: Verifier reliability
measurements.scope: Verifier 6, natural original-first diagnosis. Injected errors and unmodified controls form a separate paired challenge.
measurements.method: Natural recall = specifically located true findings / all adjudicated natural defects. Precision = actionable true findings / actionable prompts. Q22 injected defects: 12/12 detected; Q23 control false alarms: 0/12, meeting the ≤1-control criterion.
measurements.conclusion: Never combine natural and injected populations. Independently callable checking does not establish independent accuracy; Q35 held-out qualification remains open.

measurements.title: Repair, acceptance and monitoring
measurements.scope: A release cohort: 8 pages. Shared candidate-08 operations: full 38-document copied workload.
measurements.method: Count only evidence-qualified automatic releases over the 8-page cohort. Time persistent saves and take nearest-rank p95. Weekly QA samples original-side units, including absent output; a repair requires a separate finding follow-up before closure.
measurements.conclusion: A partial delivery is not whole-source completion. Original/content/policy changes reopen affected scope. Actual reviewer effort remains Q28 UNMEASURED.

title: System2B | Identify, relate and deliver Requirements

nodes.title: 01 · A source and context accepted?

items: See the proposal, reason, accepted original and complete context.
Confirm exact spans, shared conditions and one count basis.
Reject stale submissions; retain incomplete drafts separately.
A/context changes never silently revive an earlier B decision.
QA findings need explicit verification after a corrected judgment.
human.rule: B does not invent missing actors, thresholds or ontology fields. Site-specific grounding and final compliance judgment belong to future collaboration.

measurements.title: Classifier quality and abstention
measurements.scope: Classifier 5: initial 60 complete units, 41 positive (11 advisory), 19 negative. Extra negative is separate.
measurements.method: Compare proposals with frozen reference classes. Precision = TP/(TP+FP); recall = TP/all reference positives, including abstained positives. Decisiveness = non-abstained/all units. The separate extra negative is correct; combined decisive count is 54/61.
measurements.conclusion: The seven initial abstentions are negatives. These controlled source-complete inputs do not prove acceptance of production A or calibrated release.

measurements.title: Association and human review
measurements.scope: Original association and human decisions use current source, content and dependency evidence.
rows: Q30 Cached preview p95 · 0.763 s; n=20
measurements.method: Trace each judgment to the complete accepted source and context; inspect false inclusion and omission. Group overlapping source scopes into independent reviewer tasks, time active work and record confirmation/correction/unresolved outcomes. UI p95 uses ranked request durations.
measurements.conclusion: Fast evidence access is not reduced reviewer effort. Absence of a keyword is not a valid exclusion; ambiguity stays visible.

measurements.title: Subdivision mechanics and binding
measurements.scope: 10 real parents and 55 manually selected spans. Accepted-A production delivery remains separate.
measurements.method: Match exact selected quotations and parent/source bindings; reject overlap and unexplained remainder. Change context and check that children become stale. Then test delivery from actually accepted A under each reversible parent-or-children policy.
measurements.conclusion: All ten real B submissions remain blocked by unaccepted A. Valid bindings do not establish automatic semantic split accuracy or peer agreement.

measurements.title: Release, coherent output and QA
measurements.scope: B: 61 judgments; end-to-end: one source. Current candidate-08 export timing supplement.
measurements.method: Count qualified releases over their distinct populations; automatic-pass correctness has no sample at zero releases. Match saved/exported versions and count parent or children once. Weekly sampling keeps shortfalls and missing classes explicit, with separate repair follow-up.
measurements.conclusion: Q35 independent held-out qualification, Q37 live API benefit and Q38 remaining native Excel QA stay OPEN. System3 has no consumer acceptance.
